### NAME

`mermaid-cli` - mermaid-cli — command-line rendering for the Mermaid diagram language.

### SYNOPSIS & usage

*Derived from the upstream README at generation
time; verify against `--help` where the tool is
installed.*

```
npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli
```

```
mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.svg
```

### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

This is a command-line interface (CLI) for [mermaid](https://mermaid.js.org/). It takes a mermaid definition file as input and generates an SVG/PNG/PDF file as output. There's basic support for converting mermaid code blocks embedded within Markdown files. npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli Convert Mermaid mmd Diagram File To SVG mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.svg > **Note** > > See [Alternative installations](#alternative-installations) if you don't want to install the package globally. > > Locate how to call the mmdc executable for your preferred method > i.e. Docker, Yarn, NPM, local install, etc. mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.png -t dark -b transparent `mermaid-cli` supports two different
